tables.notes: Formulas are written as stored, without the leading "="; text cells keep their characters, with a line break written as the literal "\n" and a non-breaking space as "\u00a0"; numeric cells are written as Python repr(float(stored value)). Rows were chosen by the build engineer from a reading of the workbook; both passes filled every row and agreed on every cell. Both passes report that cell TST_v1.0.0!J11, the moment for task row 3, holds no formula, so the workbook computes that task with a blank moment; and that R5 tests "Please select..." without the space that the task list and the other formulas use. Both are defects of the workbook, recorded in the specification.
